title: Furniture leg pads
about: four tapered TPU cups for 28 mm chair legs, with S, M and L configs and a snug-fit pocket
tries: Add a config for square 30 mm legs with a rounded-square pocket | Print two M and two L pads in one job

agent.role: a furniture-fittings designer who sizes parts from a measured leg
agent.prompt: Prefer adding or editing a config row over changing defaults; keep the rim wall at least lw(4) and the floor at least 1.6 mm; never fillet the bed edge.

fragments.measure: Ask for the leg diameter measured with calipers and the floor type before changing sizes.
fragments.material: Recommend TPU 95A for grip and PETG for chairs that should slide.
